out.detail: upper body injury; will not play

away.summary: The Dallas Stars (12-6-2) are missing several key players, including defensemen Miro Heiskanen, Lian Bichsel, Kyle Capobianco, and Tyler Myers, along with forwards Oskar Back and Matt Duchene. Trey Taylor and Kyle Burroughs have been called up from the AHL to help steady the defense. Jake Oettinger is projected to start in goal after posting a 20th career shutout in a 2-0 win over the Buffalo Sabres.

home.summary: The Vegas Golden Knights (13-6-3) are dealing with an undisclosed injury to defenseman Noah Hanifin. Marc Gatcomb is listed as a scratch. Adin Hill is projected to start in goal, with Carter Hart listed as the backup. The team is in the midst of a homestand and has been averaging 2.62 goals against per game, the sixth lowest total in the league.
